name: Custom Table Operations
description: Register arbitrary existing database tables as config entities and do row-level CRUD on them from an admin UI.
project_description: Custom Table Operations lets a site administrator register any existing database table (typically a non-entity table created for custom functionality) as a 'dbtable' config entity, then view, add, edit and delete individual rows of that table through the Drupal admin UI. You pick the table's primary-key column and which columns to display; the module reads the live table schema with DESCRIBE and drives simple CRUD via the database API. It is intended for developer/admin housekeeping of bespoke tables. Warning from the maintainer: do not register Drupal's core tables with it.
